newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDESpar to sell one billion Coelba shares.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDESpar to sell one billion Coelba shares.

text.p: BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), will auction off Wednesday one billion voting shares in Bahia state electricity company Coelba for a minimum price of 66.35 million reais ($63.79 million), BNDESpar said in a statement.
The share block represents 10.31 percent of Coelba's voting share capital and 9.17 percent of total capital.

Fifteen financial institutions including ING Barings, Salomon Brothers/Patrimonio, Pactual and Bozano Simonsen have been chosen to coordinate the share sale which will take place on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.
Coelba is due to be privatized in July this year.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
